about_the_game:
Beastkeepers is your creature taming adventure at the bottom of the screen. Breed and train powerful creatures, battle enemies, and earn coins. Use them to unlock new creatures, upgrades, and decorations. Grow stronger and progress endlessly!

Key Features:


  • Breed and Train Unique Creatures: Nurture, and evolve your creatures into powerful beasts ready for combat. Each creature has its own set of abilities, strengths, and weaknesses. Unlock new creatures as you progress!

  • Idle Gameplay with Meaningful Progress: Beastkeepers is designed to be played even when you're not around. While you’re away, your creatures continue to fight and earn coins. Use these coins to upgrade your beasts, improve your land, and unlock new structures to automate your processes.

  • Customize and Upgrade: From creature abilities to land decoration, the game allows for a deep customization experience. Place decorative structures to enhance your land and grant passive bonuses that affect your creatures’ stats.

  • Battle Against Enemies: Your creatures will fight in automated battles, but you’ll need to strategically train and improve their skills to face tougher opponents. As you defeat enemies, you’ll earn coins and resources to upgrade your monsters and lands.
